# Verify your email
{: .no_toc }

Tell the user to check email; complete verification from the emailed link.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-04` |
| **Route** | `/verify-email` · deep link `substratal://verify-email` |
| **Who can use it** | Signed in (unverified) or token holder |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** After signup; Persistent banner on APP-01 while `email_verified` is false; Deep link `/verify-email?token=…`

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Instruction | text | User.email | "We sent a link to {email}." | GtkLabel |
| Resend email | button | POST /auth/email/verify/resend | 30 s cooldown after each send | GtkButton |
| Continue to Substratal | button | → APP-01 | unverified users may continue | GtkButton |
| Change email | link | → ACC-02 |  | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Deep link opened | `POST /auth/email/verify {token}` | 204 → success state, refresh User. 400 → "This link has expired." + Resend. |
| Resend email | `POST /auth/email/verify/resend` | Always 202 → toast "If that address needs verifying, we sent a new link." |
